_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Written for Raptor.
name: Unreal Tournament 2004
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: The 2004 arena shooter, Editor's Choice edition, with OldUnreal's community patch. It also uses the port after the server's port and the one 10 above it for server browsers, so add those too. Other settings are in System/UT2004.ini.
startup: s=System; [ "$(uname -m)" = aarch64 ] && s=SystemARM64; cd $s && exec ./ucc-bin server "{{MAP}}?game={{GAME_TYPE}}?MaxPlayers={{MAX_PLAYERS}}" port={{SERVER_PORT}} ini=../System/UT2004.ini userini=../System/User.ini -nohomedir

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Unreal Tournament 2004 with OldUnreal's community patch, installed as
# OldUnreal's own Linux installer does: the Editor's Choice DVD image from
# OldUnreal's mirrors (free to download, with Epic's blessing), unpacked with
# OldUnreal's unshield build, then the patch from GitHub, all checked against
# their SHA-256. Your settings (System/UT2004.ini, User.ini) and anything you
# add are never overwritten.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
ua="raptor-installer (+https://raptorpanel.net)"
build=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
trap 'rm -rf "$build"' EXIT
mkdir -p "$build"

case "$(uname -m)" in
x86_64) arch=amd64; zarch=x64; sys=System ;;
aarch64) arch=arm64; zarch=arm64; sys=SystemARM64 ;;
*) fail "Unreal Tournament 2004's server runs on x86-64 and ARM64 machines only." ;;
esac

want=${VERSION:-latest}
tag=$(gh-release tag OldUnreal/UT2004Patches "$want") ||
    fail "OldUnreal patch ${VERSION} doesn't exist. Check Version and reinstall."
patch=$(gh-release assets OldUnreal/UT2004Patches "$tag" | awk '$1 ~ /-Linux.*\.tar\.bz2$/ && !f { print $1; f = 1 }')
[ -n "$patch" ] || fail "OldUnreal patch $tag has no Linux build."

# Downloads <file> from <url>s, checked against its SHA-256; a good copy
# left by an interrupted install is used as it is.
fetch() {
    local out=$1 sum=$2 url
    shift 2
    [ -f "$out" ] && [ "$(sha256sum "$out" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$sum" ] && return 0
    for url in "$@"; do
        if curl -fsSL --retry 2 -A "$ua" -o "$out" "$url" &&
            [ "$(sha256sum "$out" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$sum" ]; then
            return 0
        fi
        echo "The download from ${url%/*} failed or didn't match its checksum; trying the next mirror."
    done
    rm -f "$out"
    fail "No mirror gave a good copy of ${out##*/}. Reinstall to try again."
}

iso_sum=43e9182ae20bcbc0f6f4588fee6c1b336c261f1465403118a1973b09b1a22541
if [ "$(cat .raptor-game 2>/dev/null)" != "$iso_sum" ]; then
    # 7-Zip and unshield, only for unpacking the DVD image; not kept.
    t=$(gh-release tag ip7z/7zip latest) || fail "GitHub can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
    gh-release download ip7z/7zip "$t" "7z${t//./}-linux-$zarch.tar.xz" "$build/7z.tar.xz" ||
        fail "7-Zip couldn't be downloaded from GitHub. Reinstall to try again."
    tar -xJf "$build/7z.tar.xz" -C "$build" 7zzs
    case $arch in
    amd64) us=2c790958037538fd9dd31f41eebc2a0e0e6343ac8e4a1805b0176400b1d68332 ;;
    arm64) us=51489f9768398f304e119ba36a8f1895d7e1b2bdd97bdf18c45600f69a6afd5f ;;
    esac
    fetch "$build/unshield" "$us" "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OldUnreal/FullGameInstallers/master/Linux/deps/unshield-$arch"
    chmod +x "$build/unshield"

    echo "Downloading Unreal Tournament 2004 (the 2.8 GB DVD image)"
    fetch "$build/ut2004.iso" "$iso_sum" https://files.oldunreal.net/UT2004.ISO https://files2.oldunreal.net/UT2004.ISO https://files3.oldunreal.net/UT2004.ISO
    echo "Unpacking the game"
    rm -rf "$build/cabs" "$build/data"
    "$build/7zzs" e -y -bd -o"$build/cabs" "$build/ut2004.iso" 'Disk*/*.cab' 'Disk*/*.hdr' >/dev/null ||
        fail "The DVD image couldn't be unpacked. Reinstall to try again."
    rm -f "$build/ut2004.iso"
    "$build/unshield" -d "$build/data" x "$build/cabs/data1.cab" >/dev/null ||
        fail "The game's files couldn't be unpacked. Reinstall to try again."
    rm -rf "$build/cabs"
    d="$build/data"
    # No Windows programs or default settings, as OldUnreal's installer does.
    rm -f "$d"/All_UT2004.EXE/*.exe "$d"/English_Sounds_Speech_System_Help/System/*.{bat,dll,exe}
    rm -f "$d"/English_Sounds_Speech_System_Help/System/{UT2004,User}.ini
    rm -rf "$build/game" && mkdir -p "$build/game"
    for pair in All_Animations:Animations All_Benchmark:Benchmark All_ForceFeedback:ForceFeedback All_Help:Help \
        All_KarmaData:KarmaData All_Maps:Maps All_Music:Music All_StaticMeshes:StaticMeshes All_Textures:Textures \
        All_Web:Web All_UT2004.EXE:System English_Manual:Manual US_License.int:System English_Sounds_Speech_System_Help:; do
        src=${pair%%:*} dst=${pair#*:}
        [ -d "$d/$src" ] || continue
        mkdir -p "$build/game/$dst"
        cp -rf "$d/$src/." "$build/game/$dst/"
    done
    rm -rf "$d"
    # The game's files go in without replacing any already there.
    (cd "$build/game" && find . -type f -print0) | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
        [ -e "$f" ] || { mkdir -p "$(dirname "$f")" && mv "$build/game/$f" "$f"; }
    done
    rm -rf "$build/game"
    rm -f .raptor-version
    echo "$iso_sum" > .raptor-game
fi

if [ "$(cat .raptor-version 2>/dev/null)" = "$tag" ] && [ -x "$sys/ucc-bin" ]; then
    echo "OldUnreal's patch $tag is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading OldUnreal's patch $tag"
    gh-release download OldUnreal/UT2004Patches "$tag" "$patch" "$build/patch.tar.bz2" ||
        fail "The patch download from GitHub failed. Reinstall to try again."
    rm -rf "$build/patch" && mkdir -p "$build/patch"
    tar -xjf "$build/patch.tar.bz2" -C "$build/patch"
    # The game's wrongly cased copies of packages the patch replaces, which
    # a case-sensitive file system would load too (OldUnreal's installer
    # removes them); removed first, so the patch's stay on any file system.
    for f in Bonuspack.u Gui2K4.u Gameplay.u Ipdrv.u Skaarjpack.u StreamLineFX.u UT2K4Assault.u UT2K4AssaultFull.u XVoting.u xWebAdmin.u; do
        rm -f "System/$f" "SystemARM64/$f"
    done
    # The patch's own files replace the game's.
    cp -a "$build/patch/." .
    echo "$tag" > .raptor-version
fi

# The server's settings start from the patch's defaults, as the game does on
# its first start, in System/ for every CPU; the Panel sets the port, name
# and passwords at each start.
[ -f System/UT2004.ini ] || cp "$sys/Default.ini" System/UT2004.ini
[ -f System/User.ini ] || cp "$sys/DefUser.ini" System/User.ini
chmod +x "$sys"/ucc-bin* 2>/dev/null || true
echo "Installed Unreal Tournament 2004 with OldUnreal's patch $tag."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: OldUnreal's patch, such as 3374-rc3, or latest for the newest one. Reinstall the server after changing it.

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name players see in the server browser.

variables.name: Map
variables.description: The map the server starts on, such as DM-Rankin, CTF-FaceClassic or ONS-Torlan; it must suit the game type.

variables.name: Game type
variables.description: The game type: XGame.xDeathMatch, XGame.xTeamGame, XGame.xCTFGame, XGame.xBombingRun, XGame.xDoubleDom, Onslaught.ONSOnslaughtGame or UT2k4Assault.ASGameInfo, or a mod's.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: How many players can be on the server at once.

variables.name: Password
variables.description: The password players join with. Empty, anyone can join.

variables.name: Admin password
variables.description: The password for adminlogin, which gives a player admin commands. Empty turns it off.

variables.name: Public
variables.description: True lists the server on the master servers so players find it; False keeps it unlisted.
